title: Your RAG is Unfair: Exposing Fairness Vulnerabilities in Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Backdoor Attacks
reasoning: The paper includes a primary focus on evaluating and benchmarking religious bias. It uses religious groups (specifically Jewish people as the target group, and Sikhs, Muslims, and Hindus as non-target groups) as a core part of its experimental evaluation of fairness vulnerabilities in RAG systems, providing detailed metrics and word lists associated with these religious identities.
